patch.value: Evolve bounded proposal strategies across recursive generations

Extend fixed recipe arms with a sealed typed proposal program that changes feature construction, curriculum and search strategy using development outcomes. Existing process, recipe, lineage and resource APIs remain authoritative.

A positive control promotes an actual changed strategy across two recursive generations; metadata-only changes cannot pass.; Predeclared inner and outer statistical gates, contamination checks, cohort limits and equal total optimizer and inference budgets apply.; Invalid programs stop before effects. Rejection and post-promotion regression restore the prior content-addressed program while retaining evidence.; Typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON and JSON, typed remedies, README and example, read-only public tracker validation, seeded 500-sequence state properties, interleavings, packed acquisition and npm/Bun CI evidence.

Current host version is 2026.11.4; pinned SDK 2026.11.2 public declarations expose tracker and transaction primitives but no proposer-program API. Existing recipe validation and paired evaluation-plan gates remain authoritative. Both code identity and emitted recipe instructions must change before promotion. Programme, comparisons and rejected artifacts remain in durable SDK receipts; final audit failure selects the prior artifact without deleting evidence.
